chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, from Abu al-Subah, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: When a man marries a woman while he is unable to have intercourse with women, he is given a year's respite until he treats his condition.
ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic ruling for a husband who is unable to have intercourse with his wife?
ai.summary: In *Al-Istibsar*, Shaykh al-Tusi records this ruling from Imam al-Sadi‘ (AS) establishing a one-year grace period for an *‘innun* (impotent) husband to seek treatment or consummate the marriage. This period allows for medical intervention or natural maturation, serving as a prerequisite before the wife may exercise her right to *khiyar al-bulugh* (option of maturity) or seek divorce due to non-consummation.
